cheats.name: Skip DRM authentication checkpoint
cheats.description: 하이브리드 waits for a retired LGT carrier callback (0x5001) before constructing the playable game state. The bypass treats the first post-initialization key notification (0xa100) as that handoff and selects the valid game-state subtype (3). Unlike the former compare-self patch, it leaves the earlier boot event and unrelated dispatcher traffic on their normal paths, so the title reaches gameplay without corrupting session initialization.
cheats.author: aram

patches.note: session dispatcher 0x1a28: recognize the post-initialization 0xa100 key notification as the handoff event instead of waiting for the retired 0x5001 carrier callback; earlier boot and unrelated events still use the normal fallback path
handoff handler 0x1934: `movs r4,#3` instead of `adds r4,r1,#0`, selecting the valid playable game-state constructor
